pdf_page_count fails when the supplied password does not authenticate the document

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import Xberg

do {
    let pdfBytesData = try Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: "pdf/password_protected.pdf"))
    let pdfBytesBytes = Array(pdfBytesData)
    _ = try Xberg.pdfPageCount(pdfBytes: pdfBytesBytes, password: "xberg-test-fake-wrong-password-1879")
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
